originalTitle: Market trading guide: CDSL among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news: The stock market had a big comeback on Friday, thanks to good news from other countries and strong earnings from IT companies. Some experts think Monday will be a good day to buy stocks, and they recommend two companies: CDSL and Sumitomo Chemical India. They like these companies because their stock prices have recently broken out to new highs, they have a lot of buyers interested, and other signs are pointing up. This could be a good opportunity for investors to make some money. The experts think these companies have strong momentum, which means their stock prices might keep going up.

originalTitle: Vijay Kedia buys 3.58 lakh shares in this IT company that nearly doubled investor money
simplifiedContent: Vijay Kedia, a well-known investor, has bought a significant number of shares (3.58 lakh) in a company called Exato Technologies, which is in the IT industry. This purchase has increased his total stake in the company to 9.68%. The company's stock price has gone up by over 90% in the last year, which means investors who bought the stock a year ago have almost doubled their money. This news is important because it shows that a well-known investor is interested in this company, which might attract more investors to buy its stock. The company's stock is being watched closely, especially since it's a small technology company that has shown high growth.

originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a good day on Friday, with two important indexes called Sensex and Nifty going up by over 1%. This happened because a big company called TCS had good earnings, and there were also positive signs from other countries. Now, investors are waiting to see how companies do in the first quarter to decide what to do next with their money. They will also be watching what happens in the rest of the world and how the market's technical levels change to figure out what the market will do on Monday. This will help them decide whether to buy or sell stocks.

originalTitle: Week Ahead: Wall Street braces for inflation data, big bank earnings and Middle East developments
simplifiedContent: This week, investors are waiting to see the latest numbers on how much prices are rising, which is called inflation. This information is important because it will help them guess what the Federal Reserve, the central bank of the US, will do next with interest rates. The Federal Reserve's decisions can affect the stock market, so investors are paying close attention. They will look at two types of inflation numbers: one for regular people buying things (consumer inflation) and one for businesses buying and selling goods (wholesale inflation). This information will help investors make informed decisions about their investments.

originalTitle: Mcap of 4 of top-10 most valued firms jumps  ₹92,995 cr; HDFC Bank, Airtel top gainers
simplifiedContent: The value of four of the top 10 most valuable companies in the stock market increased by ₹92,995 crore. The companies that gained value were RIL, HDFC Bank, Bharti Airtel, and LIC. On the other hand, six other top companies, including ICICI Bank and SBI, lost a combined value of ₹49,294.13 crore. This means that the total value of these four companies is now higher, which is a positive sign for investors who own their stocks. HDFC Bank and Bharti Airtel were the biggest gainers, which could be a good sign for their investors.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: SBI Funds Management IPO, Alpine Texworld IPO among new issues to open this week; full list here
simplifiedContent: This week, two companies, Alpine Texworld and SBI Funds Management, are going to sell their shares to the public for the first time, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Together, they hope to raise around ₹9,900 crore from investors. An IPO allows a company to raise money from many people, which can help it grow and expand. This is important because it gives investors a chance to buy shares in these companies and potentially earn money if the companies do well. The IPOs will be listed on the main stock market, making it easier for people to buy and sell the shares.
